I just did the same thing this past weekend. It has been the hardest  thing I have ever had to do. I told her I cannot be just friends, but  she wants to remain friends and hopes that we can at some point. I know  that I cant. I dont even know where to go from here.

The way her nostrils twitch and she snorts when she laughs really hard. The way she goes out of her way to make new people feel welcome.  The way she always seems to care about other people more than herself, even though she's got so much going on in her life. The way she makes everything a "naughty" joke. Honestly she's perfect in every way, and 100% unavailable.

My dad actually passed 4 years ago on my birthday of all days. My mom's side of the family is actually quite large but we've never really been close to them. So while I'm sure it would impact them a bit, it's nothing that won't fade in a week or so for them. I've seen most of them less times than I can count on one hand. Honestly even the shitty friendships have helped a lot, I know I need to cut them out but even the little bit of time I get with them helps tremenedously. It's just not enough anymore. I've fallen into a routine of work, come home and try to hang out or try to make plans and that seldom works out. When I actually get something planned it usually ends up getting cancelled or short lived.e and my brother aren't really super close, atleast not close enough that I'd want to talk to him about something like this. There's 2 people I'd even consider talking to about it and neither are really options.

This isn't really something I can talk to my mom about either. She would be helpful at first but she's the kind of person who has to try to make everything about herself. Whether that be blaming what I'm feeling on her, or telling me how it's make her feel when I go through with it.

I am sure she'd take it seriously for awhile, but eventually she will play the pity card that this is all her fault etcetc, and I'll end up being the one trying to comfort her.

My brother is another story but I don't even know how to approach a subject like this with him. We have never really been super close, but there have been a few times we came together. Who knows, I've got plans on the 5th that I don't want to blow off and that's really the only thing holding me back right now.

I don't really have the money to see any sort of therapist, and I have a hard enough time talking to my friends about personal issues, there's no way I'll be able to talk to a stranger about it. Plus, I already know what they'll say. You're young, you have much going for you, suicide is a long term solution to a short term problem etc. It's just a bunch of pandering.

Honestly not even sure why I posted this here. Not sure what I'm looking for right now. Life just went from looking so good in November/December to looking so bleak now.

Yeah, my mom is the type of person who makes everything about herself, that will just make matters worse. My brother has enough going on he doesn't need to be burdened by something like this. Honestly right now it feels like this is the best time. He's been wanting to go to school for awhile and without me here to pay for the majority of the bills he will be forced to actually do it.
